target_strategy.positioning: Position Denys Strakhov as a backend-focused Node.js/TypeScript developer with commercial production experience in Azure serverless systems, third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, observability and PostgreSQL-backed business systems.
target_strategy.main_angle: The primary positioning angle is reliable, integration-heavy Node.js/TypeScript backend delivery. The three strongest supporting arguments are: 1) commercial Node.js/TypeScript, Azure Functions and large-scale e-commerce experience, backed by the EPAM large-scale multi-locale e-commerce platform case; 2) practical external API, long-running workflow, retry, idempotency and data-processing experience, backed by the ProductsUp synchronization, CommerceTools integration and event-driven customer notification cases; 3) production reliability, observability, automation and data-integrity maturity, backed by the customer notification incident, Amplience automation and Factor–IT PostgreSQL migration cases.
risk_mitigation: Do not claim payment, subscription billing, marketing attribution, CRM or conversion API experience because it is not evidenced.
Do not present MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Kafka, BullMQ, AWS or GCP as production skills; emphasize transferable Azure Service Bus, Durable Functions and Cosmos DB experience only.
Keep AI-assisted development, OpenAI, FastAPI and NestJS explicitly in personal portfolio context, while highlighting human review and validation practices.
State Cologne, Germany and German work authorization clearly, but flag that cross-border remote work for a Netherlands-based employer requires confirmation.
Do not claim Upper-Intermediate English; retain the documented B1/B1+ professional-use wording and prepare for technical communication screening.

cv_content.headline: Backend-focused TypeScript Developer | Node.js | Azure Functions | REST APIs | E-commerce Integrations
summary: Backend-focused TypeScript Developer based in Cologne, Germany, with commercial Node.js/TypeScript experience across Azure Functions, Durable Functions, REST integrations and production e-commerce workflows.

Worked on a large multi-locale platform for a major European retailer, including CommerceTools product data, Amplience CMS automation, ProductsUp synchronization and event-driven customer notifications.
Strong reliability focus across asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, Jest testing, Azure Application Insights/KQL and production debugging.
Earlier PostgreSQL-heavy financial-system experience adds strength in SQL, migrations, data integrity and complex business logic.
Authorized to work in Germany; open to remote EU or Cologne-based opportunities, subject to confirmation of Netherlands cross-border arrangements.
